question: Why does the radiant twelve-souled one deserve obeisance among luminaries?
premises: The verse praises a radiant being.
It offers obeisance to that being.
inference: The verse presents the radiant being as worthy of reverence among luminaries.
uncertainties: Exact referent of the twelve-souled being is not specified.
plain_english: Obeisance to the radiant one among the twelve-souled luminaries.
